notices.documentation:
016 Microwave Oven root stage. Geometry, parameters, joints, and physics come from main.forge.js.
This stage owns the materials, the three textures, and the finish choices (stainless, black, white).
Bindings cover every part of every layout; a layout without a part (Dial or Keypad, Release button or Handle)
leaves that binding unused, which is a render notice and not an error.

015 Refrigerator root stage. Geometry, parameters, joints, and physics come from main.forge.js.
This stage owns materials, textures, and the finish choices. Bindings cover the French-door parts and the
top-freezer door; a layout without one of these parts leaves its binding unused (a render notice, not an error).
Shelves 4 and 5 keep their ForgeCAD display colours.
